      'notes', notes

);

args.query:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT m.*
  FROM measurements m
  JOIN (
    SELECT session_id, MAX(recorded_at) AS max_rec
    FROM measurements
    GROUP BY session_id
  ) t ON m.session_id = t.session_id AND m.recorded_at = t.max_rec
)
SELECT 'session_id,participant_id,condition,cognitive_score,reaction_ms,recorded_at,status,notes' || '\n' || group_concat(printf('%s,%s,%s,%d,%d,%s,%s,%s',
  session_id,
  participant_id,
  replace(condition, ',', ';'),
  cognitive_score,
  reaction_ms,
  recorded_at,
  status,
  replace(notes, '\n', ' ')
), '\n') AS csv
FROM latest;
